subpages.text: UK Manufacturer of Networking and Accessories. Categories Networking ADSL & Routers Wifi Range Extenders Wired Networking Wireless Adapters Show All Networking Accessories HDD Enclosures Peripherals Webcams Show All Accessories Travelmate Audio Batteries & Power Banks Chargers & Accessories USB Hubs & Cardreaders Show All Travelmate Networking Wireless Adapters ADDON AWP1200E Wireless AC Dual Band 1200Mbps PCI-E Adapter ADDON AWP1200E Wireless AC Dual Band 1200Mbps PCI-E Adapter Product Code: AWP1200E Availability: In Stock Description ADDON AWP1200E is a wireless dual band 1200Mbps adapter that provides PCI Express interface and is fully in compliance with IEEE802.11ac and IEEE802.11a/b/g/n dual band standards ( 2.4 G and 5G ). The wireless transmission rates can reach up to 867Mbps in 5G mode and 300Mbps in 2.4G mode. It connects your desktop computer to a high-speed Wi-Fi network, experiencing faster files transmission and internet browsing. When AWP1200 works in 11AC 5G mode, users can enjoy high performance gaming programs including HD multimedia with 3 time faster speed than previous generation 11N. This Desktop 11AC dual band PCI-E Adapter is the best choice for the desktop computer users who want to enjoy a better wireless performance and high-speed Wi-Fi network. Features: - Complies with IEEE 802.11ac, IEEE 802.11n and IEEE 802.11a / b / g standards - Supports PCI-E 1.1 X1 bus - Supports IEEE802.11n 2.0 and IEEE 802.11ac standard, 300Mbps and 11ac 867Mbps TX / RX rates - Support WPA and WPA2 to safeguard wireless network access security - Supports 20MHz / 40MHz / 80MHz bandwidth - Supports IEEE802.11e QoS Enhancement (WMM) - Supports IEEE802.11h TPC - Supports WAPI certified - Supports Cisco CCS - Supports multiple BSSID Specifications: Model AWP1200E Standard

Categories Networking ADSL & Routers Wifi Range Extenders Wired Networking Wireless Adapters Show All Networking Accessories HDD Enclosures Peripherals Webcams Show All Accessories Travelmate Audio Batteries & Power Banks Chargers & Accessories USB Hubs & Cardreaders Show All Travelmate Networking Wireless Adapters ADDON XWP3100R 5400Mbps Wireless 6E/BT5.3 MU-MIMO PCIe Adapter Card ADDON XWP3100R 5400Mbps Wireless 6E/BT5.3 MU-MIMO PCIe Adapter Card Product Code: XWP3100R Availability: In Stock Description Addon ADD-XWP3100R is a highly integrated Tri Band PCI-e adapter for desk top motherboard and supports dual-stream Wifi in 2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz and Bluetooth 5.3 which delivers significant speed increase in dense environments with up to 2400Mbps at 1024QAM / 160MHz and 573Mbps at 2.4GHz. This Intel AX210 solution adapter is equipped with two 5dBi antennas, supporting advanced technology of Intel vPro®, MU-MIMO, OFDMA, Bluetooth 5.3, 2x2 TX/RX channels and increasing throughput up to 2.5 times compared with 11ac/wifi 5. This Gigabit 2nd generation Intel Wifi 6E Technology also benefit from greater network flexibilities, reduced latency, improved liability and faster download, data backup and video streaming. It is backwards compatible with Wifi 11AC/N/G/B/A and Bluetooth 5, 4.2, 4.0 • Supports dual-stream Wifi in 2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz • Bluetooth 5.3 • Intel AX210 • Intel vPro®, MU-MIMO, OFDMA • Backwards compatible with Wifi 11AC/N/G/B/A Specifications Interface PCI-E(x1) Data Transfer Speed 574 Mbps Wireless Standards IEEE 802.11a IEEE 802.11ac IEEE 802.11ax IEEE 802.11b IEEE 802.11g IEEE 802.11n Frequency 2.4 GHz 5 GHz Dual Band Yes MU-MIMO Support Yes Buttons LED Indicators Security WEP (128 bit) WEP (64 bit) WPA WPA-PSK WPA
